bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
cd /home/admin1/projects/ai-core
python3 -B - <<'PY'
import pathlib,subprocess,json,sys,re,os
root=pathlib.Path('.ai-core')
py=root/'distillation-venv/bin/python'
log=root/'distillation-setup.log'
s=log.read_text(errors='replace')[-16000:]
# Record only public package/version and progress lines, never URLs with credentials.
lines=[x.strip() for x in s.splitlines() if re.match(r'\s*(Collecting |Downloading |Using cached |ERROR: |WARNING: )',x)]
lines=[re.sub(r'https?://\S+','[url]',x)[:250] for x in lines][-25:]
p=subprocess.run([str(py),'-m','pip','cache','dir'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=3)
cfg=json.loads(pathlib.Path('models/Qwen3.5-4B-hf-851bf6e8/config.json').read_text())
tc=cfg['text_config']
r={'pip_log':lines,'pip_cache_exists':p.returncode==0,'python':sys.version.split()[0],'config':{k:tc.get(k) for k in ('hidden_size','num_hidden_layers','vocab_size','model_type')},'model_type':cfg.get('model_type')}
body='## CPU training dependency recovery — actual pip and model config\n\n```json\n'+json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n```\n\nNo training or provider call.'
subprocess.run(['gh','issue','comment','1','--repo','seigo-gace/ai-core','--body-file','-'],input=body,text=True,capture_output=True,check=True,timeout=6)
print('CPU_TRAINING_DEPENDENCY_RECOVERY_RECORDED')
PY
